title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
title_zh: ScholarCatalyst: 一个基准，用于检索激发新研究的论文

paragraphs.en: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.
paragraphs.zh: 是什么让伟大的科学家变得伟大？ 尽管人工智能系统开始在开放问题上取得进展，但科学家在感知新问题需要从不断增长的文献档案中挖掘出哪些既有观点方面，仍然远远领先于它们。 为了研究这项技能，我们参考了那些亲身了解哪些早期工作推动了其已完成项目的研究人员，其中论文充当了指向其中观点的指引。 利用我们可规模化实现作者标注的自动化流程，我们通过让207篇近期计算机科学论文的184位第一作者标注哪些候选内容实际或可能推动了他们的项目，并附上详细的理由，从而构建出ScholarCatalyst。 我们引入了一项由作者提供判断的检索任务：给定一个初步的研究问题，仅从项目启动时可用的文献中检索这些论文。 智能体搜索的表现并不优于嵌入检索（Recall@20为0.42对比0.48），尽管它将同一个检索器作为工具调用。 即使是一个基于Claude Fable 5.1构建的智能体——它可能在训练期间见过这些已完成的论文——其Recall@20也仅达到0.51。 这些结果凸显了开发新训练方法的重要性，以赋予模型在广泛语料库中搜索的专家直觉。 我们将ScholarCatalyst视为迈向科学智能体的一步：这类智能体能够接收一个初步的想法，并指出其所需的先前研究。

paragraphs.en: To invent is to discern, to choose. — Henri Poincaré

paragraphs.en: Scientific research is inherently cumulative, with each project building on previous results and ideas. Current AI systems for research mainly accelerate progress on an already well-defined subproblem, where the remaining work is closer to engineering. Deciding which existing idea a new problem should build on is still mostly left to human researchers. An insightful prior paper can turn a vague question into a well-defined problem, for instance by revealing a limitation that motivates a new direction or suggesting an approach worth adapting, thereby shaping and accelerating— catalyzing —subsequent research. Making this choice well is a defining ability of great scientists, and a critical part of what researchers call research taste . We ask whether models can make that decision through a concrete task: given an early-stage research question, find its catalyst papers , by which we mean prior papers whose ideas did or could have meaningfully advanced the project ( Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 科学研究本质上具有累积性，每个项目都建立在先前的成果和想法之上。 当前用于研究的 AI 系统主要加速对已有明确定义的子问题的进展，而剩余的工作更接近于工程实践。 决定一个新问题应基于哪一个现有想法，这一决策目前仍主要由人类研究人员来完成。 一篇富有洞见的早期论文可以将一个模糊的问题转化为一个定义明确的问题，例如通过揭示某种局限性来启发新的研究方向，或提出值得借鉴的方法，从而塑造并加速——甚至催化——后续的研究。 做出正确的选择是杰出科学家的核心能力，也是研究人员所说的“研究直觉”的关键组成部分。 我们通过一项具体任务来探讨模型是否也能做出这种决策：给定一个早期的研究问题，找出其“催化剂论文”，即那些其想法已经或本可以对该研究项目产生重要推动作用的早期论文（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating this retrieval task requires ground truth about which papers were catalysts for a particular project. Published papers record the outcomes of completed projects, but the ideation that shaped them is largely undocumented, and bibliographies rarely distinguish the sources that provided non-obvious, critical insights from the broader set of cited works. Existing scientific retrieval benchmarks (Table 1 ) evaluate facet-level similarity or relevance to a stated information need ( Wadden et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Ajith et al., 2024 ; Asai et al., 2024 ) or derive positives from citation-intent annotations for queries that withhold the eventual method ( Garikaparthi et al., 2025 ) . These signals do not capture whether a retrieved paper could have inspired an early-stage project, especially when it was not cited by the eventual paper.
paragraphs.zh: 评估这项检索任务需要关于哪些论文是特定项目催化剂的真实信息。 已发表的论文记录了已完成项目的成果，但形成这些成果的构思过程大多没有记录，而且参考文献很少能区分出那些提供了非显而易见且关键见解的来源与所引用的更广泛文献。 现有的科学检索基准（表1）评估的是与明确信息需求在特定方面的相似性或相关性（Wadden et al., 2020；Wang et al., 2023；Ajith et al., 2024；Asai et al., 2024），或者从那些未说明最终方法的查询中，通过引用意图标注来推导出正样本（Garikaparthi et al., 2025）。 这些信号无法判断一篇被检索到的论文是否可能启发了一个早期阶段的项目，尤其是在该论文最终并未被引用的情况下。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ScholarCatalyst , a literature inspiration retrieval benchmark grounded in researchers’ firsthand knowledge of their own projects. 184 researchers who led 207 recent computer science projects verified 894 research questions as they stood before each project’s key findings, then labeled which prior papers did or could have advanced their work and explained why, including papers they had not encountered at the time. Given a question, a system must rank these papers near the top of a 191K-paper corpus restricted to work published before the project, using models whose knowledge cutoffs predate every source paper. This knowledge is rarely documented, and we collect it efficiently and at scale through an automated pipeline that only needs a paper’s arXiv ID to produce author-reviewable draft data. Because any newly published paper can become a fresh instance, the pipeline keeps ScholarCatalyst ahead of model training cutoffs and lets the benchmark grow with the literature.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ScholarCatalyst，一个基于研究人员对其自身项目第一手知识的文献灵感检索基准。207个近期计算机科学项目的负责人（共184名研究人员）在验证了每个项目关键发现提出前的894个研究问题后，标注了哪些先前发表的论文实际或可能推动了他们的工作，并解释了原因，其中包括当时尚未接触过的论文。 给定一个问题，系统必须从包含19.1万篇论文的语料库中，将这些论文排在靠前的位置；该语料库限定为项目发表前已发布的研究成果，且所用模型的知識截断时间早于每一篇源论文。 这类知识通常鲜有记录，我们通过一条自动化流程高效地大规模收集这些知识，该流程仅需论文的 arXiv ID 即可生成可供作者审阅的草稿数据。 由于任何新发表的论文都可能成为新的实例，这条流程使 ScholarCatalyst 始终领先于模型训练的知識截断时间，并让该基准能随文献发展而持续扩展。

paragraphs.en: Across sparse, dense, and multi-vector retrievers and LLM search agents, the strongest system recovers only 48% of gold (i.e., author-credited) papers in its top 20. We find that topical similarity is a weak signal: catalyst papers are no more similar to the query than related papers the authors rejected. Every search an agent issues still goes through a similarity-based retriever, so repeated querying does not help (42% vs. 48% for the retriever alone). We also evaluate Claude Fable 5.1 as a lenient upper reference because its training data may include the source papers or secondary sources describing them, and even with this advantage it misses nearly half of the gold papers in its top 20. More broadly, our results point to the need for retrieval models with an expert-level sense of which ideas matter , and ScholarCatalyst offers a way to measure progress toward them.
paragraphs.zh: 在稀疏检索器、密集检索器、多向量检索器和 LLM 搜索智能体中，性能最强的系统在其前 20 个结果中也仅能找回 48% 的黄金论文（即作者确认的论文）。 我们发现，主题相似性是一个较弱的信号：催化剂论文与查询的相似度并不高于作者拒绝的相关论文。 智能体发出的每一次搜索仍需经过基于相似性的检索器，因此重复查询并无帮助（仅使用检索器时，结果分别为 42% 和 48%）。 我们还评估了 Claude Fable 5.1，将其视为一个较为宽松的参考上限，因为其训练数据可能包含源论文或描述这些论文的次要来源；即便如此，它在前 20 个结果中仍遗漏了近一半的黄金论文。 更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，我们需要具备专家级判断哪些观点重要的检索模型，而 ScholarCatalyst 提供了一种衡量向这一目标进展的方法。

paragraphs.en: LitSearch asks authors to write 246 of its 597 queries to retrieve their own papers.

paragraphs.en: Accelerating science is a major opportunity for LLM-based agents, which increasingly can propose relevant hypotheses and research ideas ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . We deliberately ground our task in existing papers . Unlike a newly generated idea, which cannot be verified without running it ( Si et al., 2025 ; Si et al., 2026 ) , a published paper comes with a record of what worked, why, and where it fell short. The same grounding is what lets us collect ground truth, since authors can judge existing papers against what actually advanced their project. Existing scientific-discovery systems likewise draw on prior papers, either starting from a seed or target paper and exploiting its citation graph or metadata ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while others search a task-specific candidate corpus constructed in advance ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Recent work studies how LLMs can generate scientific insights by combining existing ideas ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) , further motivating the need to evaluate which prior work agents choose to draw on. ScholarCatalyst directly addresses this evaluation gap by testing whether scientific agents can retrieve insightful prior ideas for an early-stage research question, guided by project authors’ firsthand experience of what helped their research.
paragraphs.zh: 加速科学进展是基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的一个重大机遇，因为这些智能体能够越来越多地提出相关的假设和研究思路（Wang 等，2024a；Wang 等，2024b；Liu 等，2025；Liu 等，2026）。 我们有意将任务建立在现有论文的基础之上。 与新生成的想法不同——若未实际执行便无法验证（Si 等，2025；Si 等，2026）——已发表的论文附带了关于哪些方法有效、为何有效以及哪些地方存在不足的记录。 正是这种基础设定使我们能够收集基准事实，因为作者可以根据现有论文是否真正推动了其项目进展来进行判断。 现有的科学发现系统同样依赖先前的论文，它们要么从一篇种子论文或目标论文出发，利用其引用网络或元数据（Wang 等，2024a；Liu 等，2025），要么在预先构建的特定任务候选语料库中进行搜索（Wang 等，2024b；Liu 等，2026）。 近期的研究探讨了大型语言模型如何通过整合现有观点来生成科学洞见（He-Yueya 等，2026），这进一步凸显了评估智能体选择借鉴哪些先前研究成果的必要性。 ScholarCatalyst 直接针对这一评估空白展开研究，旨在检验科学智能体是否能够根据项目作者对研究成功因素的第一手经验，为早期阶段的研究问题检索到有价值的先前观点。

sents.en: Accelerating science is a major opportunity for LLM-based agents, which increasingly can propose relevant hypotheses and research ideas ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 加速科学进展是基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的一个重大机遇，因为这些智能体能够越来越多地提出相关的假设和研究思路（Wang 等，2024a；Wang 等，2024b；Liu 等，2025；Liu 等，2026）。

sents.en: We deliberately ground our task in existing papers .
sents.zh: 我们有意将任务建立在现有论文的基础之上。

sents.en: Unlike a newly generated idea, which cannot be verified without running it ( Si et al., 2025 ; Si et al., 2026 ) , a published paper comes with a record of what worked, why, and where it fell short.
sents.zh: 与新生成的想法不同——若未实际执行便无法验证（Si 等，2025；Si 等，2026）——已发表的论文附带了关于哪些方法有效、为何有效以及哪些地方存在不足的记录。

sents.en: The same grounding is what lets us collect ground truth, since authors can judge existing papers against what actually advanced their project.
sents.zh: 正是这种基础设定使我们能够收集基准事实，因为作者可以根据现有论文是否真正推动了其项目进展来进行判断。

sents.en: Existing scientific-discovery systems likewise draw on prior papers, either starting from a seed or target paper and exploiting its citation graph or metadata ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while others search a task-specific candidate corpus constructed in advance ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 现有的科学发现系统同样依赖先前的论文，它们要么从一篇种子论文或目标论文出发，利用其引用网络或元数据（Wang 等，2024a；Liu 等，2025），要么在预先构建的特定任务候选语料库中进行搜索（Wang 等，2024b；Liu 等，2026）。

sents.en: Recent work studies how LLMs can generate scientific insights by combining existing ideas ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) , further motivating the need to evaluate which prior work agents choose to draw on.
sents.zh: 近期的研究探讨了大型语言模型如何通过整合现有观点来生成科学洞见（He-Yueya 等，2026），这进一步凸显了评估智能体选择借鉴哪些先前研究成果的必要性。

sents.en: ScholarCatalyst directly addresses this evaluation gap by testing whether scientific agents can retrieve insightful prior ideas for an early-stage research question, guided by project authors’ firsthand experience of what helped their research.
sents.zh: ScholarCatalyst 直接针对这一评估空白展开研究，旨在检验科学智能体是否能够根据项目作者对研究成功因素的第一手经验，为早期阶段的研究问题检索到有价值的先前观点。

paragraphs.en: Existing scientific retrieval benchmarks evaluate how well systems find evidence for claims ( Wadden et al., 2020 ; Wadden et al., 2022 ) , retrieve documents for specified facets ( Mysore et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , and locate papers given document context or explicit information needs ( Ajith et al., 2024 ; Asai et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) . Whereas existing benchmarks provide a retrieval objective that is explicit in the query, we pose an open-ended problem that requires inferring the latent scientific relevance of papers to an early-stage research idea. MIR ( Garikaparthi et al., 2025 ) comes closest, since its queries also withhold the project’s eventual method, but it derives positives from citation-intent annotations indicating methodological influence ( Lauscher et al., 2022 ) . Rather than inferring relevance from the published record, we elicit directly from paper authors otherwise undocumented data about the research process behind it, including early-stage research questions and relevance judgments. To our knowledge, ScholarCatalyst is the first scientific literature retrieval benchmark grounded in authors’ firsthand accounts of their research process.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的科学文献检索基准评估了系统在查找主张证据（Wadden et al., 2020; Wadden et al., 2022）、为指定方面检索文档（Mysore et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2023），以及在给定文档上下文或明确信息需求时定位论文（Ajith et al., 2024; Asai et al., 2024; He et al., 2025; Park et al., 2025; Shao et al., 2025）方面的表现。 尽管现有基准在查询中明确提供了检索目标，但我们提出的则是一个开放性问题，需要推断论文与早期研究构想之间潜在的学术相关性。 MIR（Garikaparthi et al., 2025）最接近这一目标，因为其查询同样未包含项目的最终方法，但它通过引用意图标注来提取正面样本，这些标注反映了方法论上的影响（Lauscher et al., 2022）。 我们并未从已发表的文献中推断相关性，而是直接从论文作者那里获取原本未被记录的研究过程数据，包括早期研究问题和相关性判断。 据我们所知，ScholarCatalyst 是首个基于作者对其研究过程第一手描述而构建的科学文献检索基准。

paragraphs.en: Lexical retrievers ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) and embedding retrievers rank corpus papers through term overlap or learned semantic similarity ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Shanbhogue et al., 2026 ) . For a given query, these methods rank the corpus once and do not adapt the search to the returned papers. Search agents use LLM reasoning to iteratively formulate queries and invoke these retrievers as tools over multiple turns, enabling more adaptive search for complex information-seeking tasks ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Deep research systems extend this approach with subquestion decomposition, reading, and reflection over longer horizons ( Team et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . However, these agents still access the corpus through a retriever’s top- k k candidates at each step. Recent work instead gives agents direct access to the raw corpus through terminal tools such as grep and file reads, letting the language model determine how to search and interpret documents ( Li et al., 2026 ; Sen et al., 2026 ) . Whether such agentic search approaches can retrieve prior work whose scientific inspiration is latent rather than lexically explicit remains unclear.
paragraphs.zh: 词汇检索器（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009）和嵌入检索器通过术语重叠或学习到的语义相似性对语料库中的论文进行排序（Karpukhin et al., 2020；Khattab and Zaharia, 2020；Zhang et al., 2025b；Shanbhogue et al., 2026）。 对于给定的查询，这些方法会一次性对语料库进行排序，而不会根据返回的论文调整搜索策略。 搜索智能体利用大语言模型的推理能力，在多个回合中迭代构建查询，并将这些检索器作为工具调用，从而为复杂的信息获取任务实现更具适应性的搜索（Yao et al., 2022；Jin et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025）。 深度研究系统通过子问题分解、阅读以及在更长时间跨度内的反思，进一步扩展了这一方法（Team et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 然而，这些智能体在每一步仍然需要通过检索器提供的 top-k 候选项来访问语料库。 近期的研究则通过 grep 和文件读取等终端工具，让智能体直接访问原始语料库，使语言模型能够自行决定如何搜索和解读文档（Li et al., 2026；Sen et al., 2026）。 这类智能体驱动式搜索方法是否能够检索到那些科学灵感并非以词汇形式明确表达而是隐含其中的早期研究，目前仍不清楚。

paragraphs.en: ScholarCatalyst evaluates whether retrieval systems can identify catalyst papers , prior work whose ideas could inspire and help advance an early stage of research. To obtain firsthand judgments about inspiration, we ask project authors which prior papers did or could have helped advance their project and why, knowledge that is largely absent from the public record. We first define the task of retrieving useful prior work, including its query types, retrieval corpus, and evaluation metrics ( Section 3.1 ). We then describe our pipeline that supports effective and efficient data collection ( Section 3.2 ) and the subsequent author validation and revision process for finalizing the benchmark instances ( Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: ScholarCatalyst 评估检索系统是否能够识别出催化论文，即那些其思想能够启发并推动研究早期阶段发展的先前工作。 为了获得关于启发性的第一手判断，我们询问项目作者：哪些先前发表的论文实际帮助或本可能帮助推进他们的项目，以及原因是什么；而这些知识在公开记录中基本缺失。 我们首先定义检索有用先前工作的任务，包括其查询类型、检索语料库和评估指标（第 3.1 节）。 接着，我们描述支持高效且有效数据收集的流程（第 3.2 节），以及随后用于最终确定基准实例的作者验证与修订过程（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Given a query q q from the authors of the source paper S S , the task is to retrieve catalyst papers 𝒟 q + \smash{\mathcal{D}^{+}_{q}} from 𝒫 < S \smash{\mathcal{P}_{<S}} , where 𝒫 < S \smash{\mathcal{P}_{<S}} is a corpus containing papers published before source paper S S was completed. For each query q q , we also provide hard-negative documents, 𝒟 q − ⊂ 𝒫 < S \smash{\mathcal{D}^{-}_{q}\subset\mathcal{P}_{<S}} , which are related to q q but did not inspire the authors of S S .

paragraphs.en: Each query q q is a short paragraph that reconstructs the research landscape at the outset of the project underlying the source paper S S . It describes what was known, what remained unresolved, and the open question the authors set out to answer, without revealing the eventual solution. Specifically, we consider two query types that reflect how an early-stage project develops from a broad central research question into particular subfields, with an inspiring paper potentially shaping the next step at either stage.

paragraphs.en: We build an automated data construction pipeline that only requires a source paper’s arXiv ID and produces the materials required for author annotation. paragraphs.en: Source-paper and corpus processing. For each source paper S S , we use the arXiv API 1 1 1 https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/index.html to obtain metadata and source files, parse the full text into a structured representation, and resolve bibliography entries to canonical scholarly records. The resulting one-hop citation graph links inline citations to the referenced papers’ metadata and abstracts. Our retrieval corpus 𝒫 \mathcal{P} contains 190,896 papers. It combines references resolved from our source papers with 181K additional arXiv papers from 2020–2024 across major computer-science categories. Scoping 𝒫 \mathcal{P} to computer science and the source papers’ publication years keeps the corpus relevant to ScholarCatalyst without indexing all of arXiv, which now exceeds 3 million articles ( arXiv, 2026 ) . We show detailed corpus statistics in Section B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 源论文与语料库处理。 对于每篇源论文 S，我们使用 arXiv API（https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/index.html）获取元数据和源文件，将全文解析为结构化表示，并将参考文献条目关联至标准的学术记录。 由此生成的一跳引用图将内联引用与所引用论文的元数据和摘要连接起来。 我们的检索语料库 𝒫 包含 190,896 篇论文。 它整合了从源论文中解析出的参考文献，以及 2020–2024 年间来自计算机科学主要领域的另外 18.1 万篇 arXiv 论文。 将 𝒫 的范围限定在计算机科学领域及源论文的发表年份，可确保语料库与 ScholarCatalyst 保持相关性，而无需索引整个 arXiv（目前已有超过 300 万篇文章）。（arXiv, 2026） 我们在 B.2 节中展示了详细的语料库统计数据。

paragraphs.en: Pre-annotation and candidate construction. We use Gemini 3.1 Pro to generate pre-annotations from the structured source paper S S and its bibliography. These include one CoreQ , several SubQ s, and rationales explaining the proposed relevance of cited papers. We additionally retrieve uncited candidates with BM25 and Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Gemini 3.6 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) reranks the pooled candidates for scientific relevance, and the pipeline retains 10 candidates per query to balance coverage of potential false negatives with a manageable author-review workload.
paragraphs.zh: 预标注与候选构建。 我们使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro，基于结构化源论文 S S 及其参考文献生成预标注。 这些预标注包括一个 CoreQ、多个 SubQ，以及解释所引用论文相关性的论证。 我们还通过 BM25 和 Qwen3-Embedding-8B（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009；Zhang et al., 2025b）检索未被引用的候选论文。 Gemini 3.6 Flash（Google DeepMind, 2026b）对合并后的候选论文进行科学相关性的重新排序，该流程每条查询保留 10 篇候选论文，以在覆盖潜在假阴性结果与保持作者评审工作量可控之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Author validation and revision. Through a web interface, authors provide an account of the research underlying their source paper S S and assess the relevance of candidate papers, as shown in Figure 3 . Starting from the pre-annotation of Section 3.2 , they can validate, revise, or rewrite any component to reflect their own account of the research ( Table 7 shows one validated query set). For each query q q , authors label every candidate from Section 3.2 as offering an insightful idea for pursuing q q or not, which yields the positives 𝒟 q + \mathcal{D}^{+}_{q} and hard negatives 𝒟 q − \mathcal{D}^{-}_{q} , and they explain each judgment. Together, these author-validated task instances constitute the benchmark’s relevance supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 作者验证与修订。 通过网页界面，作者会说明其源论文 S S 所依据的研究内容，并评估候选论文的相关性，如圖 3 所示。 从第 3.2 节的预标注开始，他们可以验证、修订或重写任何组成部分，以反映自己对研究的描述（表 7 展示了一组经过验证的查询）。 对于每个查询 q q ，作者需要为第 3.2 节中的每个候选论文标注其是否提供了推进 q q 研究的深刻见解，由此得到正样本 𝒟 q + \mathcal{D}^{+}_{q} 和困难负样本 𝒟 q − \mathcal{D}^{-}_{q} ，同时他们还需解释每一项判断。 这些经过作者验证的任务实例共同构成了该基准测试的相关性监督机制。

paragraphs.en: Post-processing. We manually review all finalized task instances for consistency with the task definition, paying attention to whether queries describe the research question from an early-stage perspective. Of the 894 queries, 764 (85.5%) pass this review unchanged. In the rest, we reword a phrase that gives away the eventual solution or treats the work as complete, keeping the authors’ meaning and voice and changing nothing else.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation corpus of 191K computer-science papers is far smaller than the three million papers on arXiv ( arXiv, 2026 ) , among which researchers are able to find work that inspires a project. Retrieval in this corpus is therefore an easier version of the problem researchers actually face. In this section, we ask: can current retrieval systems identify the catalyst papers that inspired a project from among the many topically related papers in the corpus? If not, where do they fail?

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three search agents that represent common designs in the literature. The grep agent follows DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) and searches titles and abstracts with regular expressions. The tool-calling agent follows the search-then-select structure for literature search ( He et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . The deep research agent adopts the workflow of deep research systems ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) : it breaks the query into subquestions and iterates over search, reading, and synthesis. The latter two agents retrieve candidates for their search queries with Gemini Embedding 2. We use GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) and o3 ( OpenAI, 2026e ) as backbone models since they are among the strongest models with a knowledge cutoff (June 2024) before all source papers. To compare against a recent frontier model, we also evaluate Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , which may have seen most source papers during training (June 2026 cutoff). Following previous work ( Thakur et al., 2021 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Tchuindjo et al., 2026 ) , we report nDCG@20 and Recall@ k k ( k = 5 , 20 , 100 k=5,20,100 ). Full experimental details are provided in Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: All systems struggle to retrieve catalyst papers. Current retrievers miss most of the papers that inspired a project ( Table 3 ). General-purpose dense retrievers perform best, yet place 39% of author-identified inspiration papers in the top 20 for CoreQ and 51% for SubQ . Scientific-document retrievers (SPECTER2, OpenScholar) trail the general-purpose models by at least 16 points on CoreQ and 27 points on SubQ at Recall@20. BM25 and LateOn trail by 15–16 points on CoreQ and 18–25 points on SubQ . Together, these results suggest that domain-specific training on citation signals does not by itself solve this task. Among the pre-cutoff systems in our main experiment, CoreQ is harder than SubQ , consistent with its longer queries and smaller, almost entirely cited positive sets ( Table 2 ). We show later that reranking with an oracle candidate pool recovers part of this gap ( Section 4.4 ).

paragraphs.en: We attribute this gap to candidate coverage , since regardless of how a model reasons, an agent can interact with the corpus only through its search queries. Consistent with this account, agent recall rises with backbone capability yet remains close to the embedding retriever’s even for the strongest model ( Figure 6 ). If coverage is the limiting factor, progress will require embedding retrievers that surface inspiration papers in the first place and agents that build on those results to guide further exploration. paragraphs.en: Inspiration relations are diverse and not captured by similarity. Prompting an LLM judge to classify each of the 663 key-inspiration rationales under a nine-type taxonomy (Appendix B.3 ), we find that authors most often credit a technique they adapted ( method ), empirical findings that supported a direction ( evidence ), an idea extended to a new setting ( generalization ), or a limitation that motivated a new approach ( limitation ), with more than one type applying to 55.8% of rationales ( Figure 7 ). Similarity to the query does not identify these papers: measuring lexical similarity as the fraction of unique query words in a candidate’s title and abstract, and semantic similarity as cosine similarity under Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , hard negatives are at least as similar to the query as positives on both measures ( Table 11 ). This also limits agentic search, where grep and embedding tools construct the candidate pool before an agent can reason about which papers could inspire a project.

sents.en: Similarity to the query does not identify these papers: measuring lexical similarity as the fraction of unique query words in a candidate’s title and abstract, and semantic similarity as cosine similarity under Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , hard negatives are at least as similar to the query as positives on both measures ( Table 11 ).

sents.en: This also limits agentic search, where grep and embedding tools construct the candidate pool before an agent can reason about which papers could inspire a project.

paragraphs.en: Stronger rerankers benefit more from better candidate coverage. To separate retrieval coverage from recognition performance, we apply LLM-based reranking to the top- K K candidates from Gemini-Embedding-2 on a randomly sampled subset of 50 CoreQ and 50 SubQ queries. We compare reranking with and without gold injection, which replaces negative candidates with positive papers missing from the set while keeping the pool size fixed. Stronger rerankers gain more in Recall@5 from gold injection ( Figure 6 ). The growing gap suggests that candidate coverage limits how much we can benefit from stronger rerankers: their ability to select useful papers matters only when those papers enter the pool. Better retrieval could therefore yield larger gains as rerankers improve. Reranking prompts and procedures are provided in Section D.2 .

paragraphs.en: Agents benefit from source context but not from fuller reading. We vary two kinds of agent context: information about the source paper and how much of each retrieved paper the agent reads. With a Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026c ) (cutoff March 2026) tool-calling agent on the 203-query cutoff split ( Table 4 ), the source title and abstract raise Recall@20 by 0.11 for CoreQ and 0.02 for SubQ , while web search changes it by at most 0.01. The source bibliography, which contains 95% of CoreQ gold papers, raises it by 0.35. Without search tools, the model given the title and abstract reaches only 0.31 CoreQ Recall@20, below corpus search alone, so source context helps by guiding search rather than through memory. In contrast, letting a GPT-4.1 tool-calling agent read beyond abstracts on 50 queries per type changes Recall@20 by at most 0.04 ( Figure 11 ), and the best SubQ policy still trails the retriever (0.50 versus 0.55). Together, these results suggest that the bottleneck lies in knowing what to search for rather than in understanding the papers already found, consistent with the candidate-coverage explanation above. Source information is used only in this analysis, and Sections C.3 and D.5 give details.

paragraphs.en: Query rewriting does not consistently improve retrieval. We test whether an LLM can improve retrieval by reasoning over the original research question to generate single-query expansions, multiple queries, or hypothetical abstracts ( Gao et al., 2023 ) . We evaluate these strategies on 50 queries of each type, using GPT-4.1 for generation and Gemini-Embedding-2 for retrieval. Neither single-query expansion nor multi-query generation yields a meaningful improvement, while both HyDE variants substantially reduce recall ( Table 5 ). If the retriever’s misses were a matter of phrasing, an LLM that reads the research question should be able to recover some of them by rewording. That none of these strategies does so suggests the embedding space itself does not place inspiration papers near their queries, consistent with the similarity analysis in Section 4.3 . We show prompts and implementation details in Section D.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 查询重写并不总能提升检索效果。 我们测试了大型语言模型（LLM）是否能够通过推理原始研究问题来生成单查询扩展、多查询或假设摘要，从而提升检索效果（Gao et al., 2023）。 我们使用 GPT-4.1 进行生成，并使用 Gemini-Embedding-2 进行检索，在每种类型的 50 条查询上评估了这些策略。 无论是单查询扩展还是多查询生成，都未能带来显著的提升，而两种 HyDE 变体均大幅降低了召回率（表 5）。 如果检索器未能找到的文献只是措辞问题，那么能够阅读研究问题的大型语言模型应该可以通过改写措辞来找回其中一部分文献。 这些策略均未实现该目标，表明嵌入空间本身并未将启发性的论文与对应的查询置于相近位置，这与第 4.3 节中的相似性分析一致。 我们在 D.4 节中展示了提示词和实施细节。

paragraphs.en: We introduced ScholarCatalyst , a benchmark for one ingredient of research ability: identifying prior papers whose ideas could help a project move forward. Drawing on 184 researchers’ own accounts of what shaped their work, we capture judgments that the published record largely omits. Current systems recover only a fraction of the papers that authors credit, and agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval, largely because limited candidate coverage keeps many useful papers out of reach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ScholarCatalyst，这是一个用于衡量研究能力中一个要素的基准：识别那些其思想能够推动项目进展的先前论文。 基于 184 位研究人员对自己工作形成过程的描述，我们捕捉到了那些在已发表记录中基本被忽略的判断。 现有系统仅能找回作者所认可论文的一小部分，而智能体搜索的表现也不优于嵌入检索，这主要是因为候选论文覆盖范围有限，导致许多有用论文无法被获取。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. ScholarCatalyst covers computer science papers from 2025–2026 with uneven representation across research areas (Table 8 ), so our findings may not transfer to other fields. Our labels are retrospective judgments by paper authors and are thus subject to hindsight. A more fundamental open question is the skyline, i.e., the performance ceiling of this task. As a point of reference, the human reference accuracy on ImageNet (94.9% top-5 ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) ) was later exceeded, and reannotation studies found that subsequent gains increasingly reflected the idiosyncrasies of the original labels ( Beyer et al., 2020 ; Shankar et al., 2020 ) . Catalyst paper retrieval is harder to audit this way, since relabeling by anyone other than the authors would be costly and would measure a different target, namely what an informed outsider can infer. Still, a preliminary comparison on one paper with three author-annotators in ScholarCatalyst found that coauthors marking only about seven positives per thread recovered 43–60% of the first author’s labels at 84–88% precision. This is well above the best system’s overall R@5 of 0.24, which suggests considerable room for improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 ScholarCatalyst 涵盖了 2025–2026 年间的计算机科学论文，但不同研究领域的代表性并不均衡（表 8），因此我们的研究结果可能无法推广到其他领域。 我们的标签是论文作者基于事后回顾做出的判断，因此不可避免地受到后见之明效应的影响。 一个更根本的开放性问题是该任务的“天际线”，即其性能上限。 作为参考，ImageNet 上的人类参考准确率（94.9% 的 top-5 准确率（Russakovsky 等人，2015））后来被超越，而重新标注研究发现，此后的提升越来越多地反映了原始标签的独特性（Beyer 等人，2020；Shankar 等人，2020）。 通过这种方式审计 Catalyst 论文检索更为困难，因为由作者以外的人进行重新标注成本高昂，且衡量的是另一个目标，即知情的外部人员能够推断出的内容。 尽管如此，在 ScholarCatalyst 中对一篇有三名作者参与标注的论文进行的初步比较发现，共同作者每条线索仅标注约七个正例，就能以 84–88% 的精确率恢复第一作者 43–60% 的标签。 这一结果远高于最佳系统的整体 R@5（0.24），表明该任务仍有较大的改进空间。

sents.en: As a point of reference, the human reference accuracy on ImageNet (94.9% top-5 ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) ) was later exceeded, and reannotation studies found that subsequent gains increasingly reflected the idiosyncrasies of the original labels ( Beyer et al., 2020 ; Shankar et al., 2020 ) .
sents.zh: 作为参考，ImageNet 上的人类参考准确率（94.9% 的 top-5 准确率（Russakovsky 等人，2015））后来被超越，而重新标注研究发现，此后的提升越来越多地反映了原始标签的独特性（Beyer 等人，2020；Shankar 等人，2020）。

sents.en: Catalyst paper retrieval is harder to audit this way, since relabeling by anyone other than the authors would be costly and would measure a different target, namely what an informed outsider can infer.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式审计 Catalyst 论文检索更为困难，因为由作者以外的人进行重新标注成本高昂，且衡量的是另一个目标，即知情的外部人员能够推断出的内容。

sents.en: Still, a preliminary comparison on one paper with three author-annotators in ScholarCatalyst found that coauthors marking only about seven positives per thread recovered 43–60% of the first author’s labels at 84–88% precision.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，在 ScholarCatalyst 中对一篇有三名作者参与标注的论文进行的初步比较发现，共同作者每条线索仅标注约七个正例，就能以 84–88% 的精确率恢复第一作者 43–60% 的标签。

sents.en: This is well above the best system’s overall R@5 of 0.24, which suggests considerable room for improvement.
sents.zh: 这一结果远高于最佳系统的整体 R@5（0.24），表明该任务仍有较大的改进空间。

paragraphs.en: Outlook. Recent work on reasoning-intensive retrieval evaluates relevance relations that require reasoning to recognize ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Tchuindjo et al., 2026 ) . ScholarCatalyst pushes further, requiring judgments of how prior ideas could advance a research project. We see two milestones ahead. The first is expert-level retrieval, matching a domain expert’s judgment within their own field. The second is retrieval beyond any individual expert : being able to exercise that level of intuition across a breadth of fields no single researcher can follow. This breadth may be where such systems help most, since nearly half of the papers our authors credit (49.5%) come from outside their project’s subject area, and 43.6% of subfield-specific positives were never cited in the source paper. Researchers may therefore be limited more by what they have seen than by how well they judge it. The full literature makes this gap far larger than our benchmark shows: Semantic Scholar alone indexes over 225M papers ( Kinney et al., 2023 ) , compared with 190k in our corpus. What stands between current systems and both milestones is an expert-level sense of which ideas matter , and we hope ScholarCatalyst offers a starting point for developing it. If undiscovered public knowledge ( Swanson, 1986 ) is as common as our results imply, models capable of expert judgment across fields could unlock a large backlog of progress hidden in plain sight.
paragraphs.zh: Outlook。 近期关于推理密集型检索的研究评估了需要推理才能识别的相关性关系（Xiao 等，2024；Su 等，2025；Tchuindjo 等，2026）。 ScholarCatalyst 更进一步，要求判断先前的观点如何能够推动一个研究项目的发展。 我们看到了两个即将到来的里程碑。 第一个是专家级检索，即能够匹配领域专家在其自身专业领域的判断。 第二个是超越任何单个专家的检索：能够在广泛的不同领域内运用这种直觉水平，而这些领域并非单个研究人员所能全部掌握的。 这种广度或许正是此类系统最能发挥作用的领域，因为我们的作者所引用的论文中近一半（49.5%）来自其项目主题领域之外，而 43.6% 的特定子领域的正面引用在原始论文中从未被提及。 因此，研究人员可能更多受到已有知识储备的限制，而非判断能力本身的限制。 完整的文献库使这一差距比我们基准测试所显示的要大得多：仅 Semantic Scholar 就收录了超过 2.25 亿篇论文（Kinney 等，2023），而我们的语料库中仅有 19 万篇。 当前系统与这两个里程碑之间的障碍，是一种能够判断哪些观点重要的专家级直觉，我们希望 ScholarCatalyst 能为培养这种直觉提供一个起点。 如果尚未被发现的公开知识（Swanson，1986）正如我们的结果所暗示的那样普遍，那么能够在跨领域进行专家级判断的模型，或许能够释放出大量隐藏在明处的、尚未实现的进步成果。

paragraphs.en: ScholarCatalyst evaluates whether a retrieval system can find prior work whose ideas would have been insightful for pursuing a research project, rather than papers that are merely topically similar. Each instance is anchored in a completed source paper and pairs its central research question and distinct research directions with author-validated positive papers, topically related hard negatives, and a temporally restricted search corpus. The 207 author-validated instances contribute 894 queries: 207 core research queries and 687 subfield-specific queries. This appendix first defines the information in one benchmark instance ( Section B.1 ), then reports the composition of the instances and corpus ( Section B.2 ), and finally examines the kinds of inspiration relations the benchmark captures ( Section B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: ScholarCatalyst 会评估一个检索系统能否找到那些其研究思路对推进研究项目具有启发意义的先前工作，而不仅仅是主题相似但缺乏深度的论文。 每个实例都以一篇已完成的基础论文为锚点，将其核心研究问题和明确的研究方向与作者验证过的正面论文、主题相关但难度较高的负面论文以及时间范围受限的检索语料库进行配对。 这 207 个经作者验证的实例共提供了 894 条查询：包括 207 条核心研究查询和 687 条细分领域专用查询。 本附录首先定义了一个基准实例中包含的信息（B.1 节），接着报告了这些实例和语料库的构成（B.2 节），最后探讨了该基准所捕捉到的各类启发关系（B.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: This section provides further detail on the analysis of author-identified inspiration in Section 4.3 and presents additional qualitative examples. To examine the inspirations captured by ScholarCatalyst beyond topical relevance, we qualitatively analyze author-provided rationales for catalyst papers. We first introduce a multi-label taxonomy of inspiration relations, and then present case studies illustrating cross-subfield transfer, the context-dependent role of prior work, and the imperfect correspondence between citation and inspiration. The authors’ accounts offer a rare view of the research process that finished papers seldom document: which prior ideas researchers found useful, and why. We find that these judgments are diverse in kind and unrelated to similarity, and that neither citations nor an LLM reading the finished paper can recover them.

paragraphs.en: Inspiration relations are diverse and not captured by similarity. Prompting an LLM judge to classify each of the 663 key-inspiration rationales under a nine-type taxonomy, we find that authors most often credit a technique they adapted ( method ), empirical findings that supported a direction ( evidence ), an idea extended to a new setting ( generalization ), or a limitation that motivated a new approach ( limitation ), with more than one type applying to 55.8% of rationales ( Figure 7 ). Similarity to the query does not identify these papers: measuring lexical similarity as the fraction of unique query words in a candidate’s title and abstract, and semantic similarity as cosine similarity under Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , hard negatives are at least as similar to the query as positives on both measures ( Table 11 ). This also limits agentic search, where grep and embedding tools construct the candidate pool before an agent can reason about which papers could inspire a project.

paragraphs.en: Citation Status Is an Imperfect Proxy for Inspiration. Citation status and author-identified inspiration can diverge in both directions. Table 12 illustrates one source-paper instance in which two of four CoreQ positives are uncited, while two cited papers are hard negatives. The uncited positives informed the source paper’s exploration and offline-learning mechanisms, whereas the cited hard negatives are topically adjacent but did not shape its approach. This pattern also appears at scale: 43.6% of SubQ positives are not cited by the source paper, and 67.8% of those share no references with it. Even among cited papers, citation intent does not single out inspirations: only 46.2% of CoreQ and 34.0% of SubQ positives carry a uses or extends label ( Lauscher et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 引用状态并非衡量启发性的完美指标。 引用状态与作者明确指出的启发性来源可能朝两个不同方向偏离。 表12展示了一个源论文实例：在四个CoreQ阳性论文中，有两个未被引用，而两个被引用的论文则属于难以归类的阴性案例。 那些未被引用的阳性论文为源论文的探索机制和离线学习机制提供了启发，而被引用的难以归类阴性论文虽然在主题上相近，却并未影响其研究方法。 这种模式在更大规模的数据中同样存在：43.6%的SubQ阳性论文未被源论文引用，其中67.8%的论文与源论文没有任何共同参考文献。 即使在被引用的论文中，引用意图也无法明确识别出启发性来源：仅有46.2%的CoreQ阳性论文和34.0%的SubQ阳性论文带有“使用”或“扩展”标签（Lauscher et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: Diversity of Inspiration Relations. Prior work inspires new research through diverse mechanisms, including direct method transfer, generalization to a new setting, limitations of existing work, and conceptual reframing. To characterize how a key inspiration paper shaped a target work, we define a nine-type taxonomy, given in Table 13 , and prompt an LLM judge to label each core-research-query key-inspiration rationale with every type it clearly expresses. To capture the ways a single paper can shape a project, we allow each rationale to receive multiple type labels. The rationales receive 1.69 labels on average, with 55.8% receiving two or more and 12.7% receiving three or more. This pattern shows that inspiration often operates through several mechanisms at once.
paragraphs.zh: 灵感关系的多样性。 先前的研究通过多种机制激发了新的研究，包括直接的方法迁移、向新场景的推广、现有研究的局限性以及概念上的重新框架。 为了描述一篇关键的灵感论文如何塑造目标研究，我们定义了一个包含九种类型的分类体系（见表13），并提示一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判为每个“核心研究问题-关键灵感”的论证标注其明确表达的每一种类型。 为了捕捉单篇论文可能影响项目的不同方式，我们允许每个论证接收多个类型标签。 这些论证平均获得了1.69个标签，其中55.8%获得了两个或更多标签，12.7%获得了三个或更多标签。 这一模式表明，灵感通常通过多种机制同时发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Agents return rankings of different lengths, so we score each on a depth-100 list. The list starts with the agent’s ranking, adds up to 25 papers the agent saw but did not rank, in discovery order, and fills the rest with the retriever ranking of the original query, without duplicates or the source paper. The cap of 25 keeps an agent that sees many papers but ranks few from displacing the retriever back-fill. R@5 and R@20 thus come from the agent’s own ranking unless it holds fewer than k k papers, which happens mainly for the grep agent (440 of 894 queries at R@20, against 10 and 95 for the tool-calling and deep research agents, and at most 93 for any Claude Fable 5.1 row). Trajectory recall is the share of gold papers among the papers an agent sees during its run.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体返回的长度各异的排名列表，因此我们对每个智能体在深度为 100 的列表中打分。 该列表首先列出智能体的排名，接着按发现顺序添加智能体已看到但未排名的最多 25 篇论文，其余位置则用原始查询的检索器排名填充，且不含重复项或源论文。 25 篇的上限可防止那些看到大量论文但仅对少数论文进行排名的智能体挤占检索器的补充结果。 因此，除非智能体持有的论文数量少于 k（这种情况主要出现在 grep 智能体中：在 R@20 时，894 次查询中有 440 次出现该情况，而工具调用和深度研究智能体分别为 10 次和 95 次，任何 Claude Fable 5.1 行的最多也仅为 93 次），否则 R@5 和 R@20 均源自智能体自身的排名。 轨迹召回率是指智能体在执行过程中所看到论文中，属于黄金标准论文的比例。

paragraphs.en: The agent combines the ReAct function-calling pattern ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , the five-round budget of PaperScout ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , and the search-then-select design of PaSa ( He et al., 2025 ) . It first searches the query as written, then runs up to 5 rounds, each one backbone reply with any number of search calls. Returned papers enter a pool of at most 60. The backbone then scores each pooled paper from 0 to 10 from its title and abstract, by how much its ideas could help a researcher pursue the query, and the scores sorted with ties in discovery order give the ranking. We do not run PaSa or PaperScout as released, because both search the web and PaperScout releases no checkpoint of its trained policy, whose base model has no vendor-stated knowledge cutoff. We omit their citation-expansion step because the corpus has no citation graph resolved to corpus papers.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体结合了 ReAct 函数调用模式（Yao 等人，2022）、PaperScout 的五轮预算（Pan 等人，2026）以及 PaSa 的“先搜索后选择”设计（He 等人，2025）。 它首先按原样搜索查询，然后运行最多 5 轮，每轮由主干模型回复一次，并可伴随任意次数的搜索调用。 返回的论文将进入一个最多包含 60 篇论文的池子。 随后，主干模型根据每篇池中论文的标题和摘要，从 0 到 10 为其评分，评分依据是这些论文的观点在多大程度上能帮助研究人员推进查询；评分结果按分数排序，若分数相同则按发现顺序排列，从而得出最终排名。 我们没有运行原始发布的 PaSa 或 PaperScout，因为两者都会搜索网络，且 PaperScout 并未发布其训练策略的检查点，而该策略的基础模型也没有供应商声明的知识截止时间。 我们省略了它们的引文扩展步骤，因为语料库中不存在已解析到语料库论文本身的引文图。

paragraphs.en: The agent follows the plan, search, read, and synthesize procedure of deep research systems ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , with the same search tool and o3 ( OpenAI, 2026e ) as backbone. It splits the query into at most 6 sub-questions, searches the query as written, then makes up to 20 searches, 10 reads, and a pool of 150 papers. A read returns the paper’s title and abstract. After every 5 calls, a reflection step asks which sub-questions remain uncovered. A final synthesis call ranks up to 50 pooled papers by usefulness, and this list is the ranking, with no per-paper judge.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体遵循深度研究系统的规划、搜索、阅读和综合流程（OpenAI，2025；Zhang 等，2025a），并以相同的搜索工具和 o3（OpenAI，2026e）作为基础架构。 它将查询拆分为最多 6 个子问题，按原样搜索该查询，然后执行最多 20 次搜索、10 次阅读，并从 150 篇论文中筛选出候选论文。 一次阅读操作会返回论文标题和摘要。 每执行 5 次调用后，会进入一个反思步骤，询问哪些子问题仍未得到覆盖。 最后的综合调用会根据有用性对最多 50 篇候选论文进行排序，该列表即为最终排名，且不对单篇论文进行单独评判。

paragraphs.en: We re-implement DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) , which searches the raw corpus using shell commands rather than a retriever. The released harness has read and shell tools and a 300-turn budget; ours has one shell tool, 20 rounds, and results truncated to 4,000 characters. The corpus is given as monthly files with one paper per line (identifier, title, abstract, date), and the prompt asks the agent to search abstracts with regular expressions and return an ordered list of identifiers. The backbone is GPT-4.1.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重新实现了 DCI-Agent-Lite（Li 等人，2026），该模型使用 shell 命令而非检索器来搜索原始语料库。 已发布的测试框架包含读取和 shell 工具，并设有 300 轮次预算；我们的版本仅包含一个 shell 工具、20 轮次，且结果被截断为 4,000 个字符。 语料库以月度文件形式提供，每行一个论文（标识符、标题、摘要、日期），提示要求智能体使用正则表达式搜索摘要，并返回一个有序的标识符列表。其基础模型是 GPT-4.1。

paragraphs.en: We also run all three agents with Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , which compares the procedures using a single backbone. Its June 2026 knowledge cutoff follows all but 6 of the 207 source papers, so these rows fall outside the rule of Section 4.1 and are marked in Table 3 . The model’s safety classifiers sometimes decline a call, which we treat as an empty reply. Declines occur on 47 of the 894 queries for the tool-calling agent, 95 for the deep research agent, and 33 for the grep agent. About half of the deep research agent’s declines are labeled as requests for the model’s reasoning, almost all at or right after the reflection step; all others are labeled biology or cyber-security risk. A declined judge call ranks the paper after all scored papers, a declined loop turn ends the search, and a declined synthesis leaves the deep research agent with only the seen papers and the back-fill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用 Claude Fable 5.1（Anthropic，2026）运行了全部三个智能体，该模型通过单一主干模型对流程进行比较。 其 2026 年 6 月的知识截止日涵盖了 207 篇源论文中的 201 篇，因此这些行超出了第 4.1 节的规则范围，并在表 3 中进行了标记。 该模型的安全分类器有时会拒绝调用，我们将其视为空回复。 在工具调用智能体的 894 次查询中，有 47 次遭到拒绝；深度研究智能体有 95 次，grep 智能体有 33 次。 深度研究智能体被拒绝的调用中，约一半被标记为对模型推理能力的请求，几乎全部发生在反思步骤或紧随其后；其余所有情况均被标记为生物学或网络安全风险。 被拒绝的法官调用会将该论文排在所有已评分论文之后，被拒绝的循环回合会终止搜索，而被拒绝的合成操作则会使深度研究智能体仅保留已见的论文和补充内容。

paragraphs.en: Closed-book (recall-from-memory). A backbone may know the source papers’ bibliographies from training, so part of its agent’s recall could come from memory. To measure this, the backbone receives the query and the source paper’s title and abstract, has no tools, and names up to 30 prior papers. Each title is resolved to the top hit of a retriever search under the temporal cutoff, with no similarity threshold, and we drop duplicates, titles whose search returns nothing, and the source paper.
paragraphs.zh: 闭卷（回忆记忆）。 骨干模型可能通过训练记住了源论文的参考文献，因此其智能体的回忆部分可以来自记忆。 为了衡量这一点，骨干模型会接收查询、源论文的题目和摘要，但没有可用工具，最多只能命名 30 篇先前的论文。 每个题目都会被解析为检索器在时间截止限制下搜索出的最佳结果，且没有相似性阈值；我们会排除重复项、搜索无结果的题目以及源论文本身。

paragraphs.en: Web search. This tests whether web access, where the source paper and its citations may appear, can substitute for the local corpus. The agent also gets a web-search tool (ten results per call) and a page-reading tool (pages truncated to 6,000 characters, at most five per query), and must call a tool in its first two rounds. A web result enters the pool only if its address contains an arXiv identifier or its normalized title matches a corpus paper. Other results are shown to the agent but not pooled.
paragraphs.zh: 网页搜索。 此测试旨在检验能否用网页访问来替代本地语料库，因为源论文及其引用文献可能出现在网页上。 智能体还配备了一个网页搜索工具（每次调用返回十个结果）和一个页面阅读工具（每页内容截断至 6,000 个字符，每次查询最多读取五页），并且必须在最初的两轮中调用至少一个工具。 只有当网页结果的地址包含 arXiv 标识符，或其规范化标题与语料库中的某篇论文匹配时，该结果才会被纳入结果池。 其他结果会展示给智能体，但不会被纳入结果池。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives details and supplementary results for our extended comparison of embedding retrievers and for the analyses of LLM reranking, knowledge cutoffs, query generation, full-text reading, and agent search failures.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细阐述了我们对嵌入检索器的扩展比较，以及对 LLM 重排序、知识截止时间、查询生成、全文阅读和智能体搜索失败的分析与补充结果。

paragraphs.en: This section reports extended results for a broader set of recent embedding retrievers, including models trained on scientific documents and models optimized for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Recently, several embedding retrievers have been developed for reasoning-intensive retrieval, where identifying relevant documents for complex queries requires reasoning beyond surface-level semantic matching ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Tchuindjo et al., 2026 ) . We evaluate SciNCL ( Ostendorff et al., 2022 ) , OpenScholar ( Asai et al., 2024 ) , GTE-Qwen2-7B ( Li et al., 2023 ) , ReasonEmbed ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , INF-X-Retriever ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , Llama NV-Embed-Reasoning-3B ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , and DIVER ( Long et al., 2025 ) . Interestingly, none of the reasoning-optimized models improves over the strongest general-purpose embeddings. Their lack of gains suggests that current objectives for reasoning-intensive retrieval do not adequately capture the relationships that make a prior paper useful for advancing a research project. As discussed in Section 5 , closing this gap may require an expert-level sense of which ideas matter, enabling retrieval of useful connections across fields beyond the scope of any individual expert.
paragraphs.zh: 本节报告了针对近期更广泛嵌入检索器模型的扩展结果，包括在科学文献上训练的模型以及为推理密集型检索优化的模型。 近期，已有多种面向推理密集型检索的嵌入检索器被开发出来，这类检索需要识别复杂查询的相关文献，其要求已超越了表层语义匹配（Xiao 等，2024；Su 等，2025；Tchuindjo 等，2026）。 我们评估了 SciNCL（Ostendorff 等，2022）、OpenScholar（Asai 等，2024）、GTE-Qwen2-7B（Li 等，2023）、ReasonEmbed（Chen 等，2025）、INF-X-Retriever（Yao 等，2025）、Llama NV-Embed-Reasoning-3B（NVIDIA，2026）以及 DIVER（Long 等，2025）。 有趣的是，所有针对推理优化的模型均未超越最强的通用嵌入模型。 这些模型未能取得性能提升，表明当前面向推理密集型检索的目标尚未充分捕捉到那些使一篇早期论文对推进研究项目具有实用价值的关联关系。 如第 5 节所述，要弥合这一差距，可能需要具备专家级的判断力，以识别哪些理念至关重要，从而实现跨领域的有用关联检索，而这些关联已超出任何单一专家的认知范围。

paragraphs.en: We test whether an LLM can reorder the retriever’s candidates to place gold papers higher, using two procedures over candidate pools from Gemini-Embedding-2. The listwise reranker gives the top 20 candidates to a single LLM call, which returns them in ranked order. The tournament reranker handles larger pools by ranking batches of b = 20 b=20 papers and promoting the top k = 4 k=4 of each batch to the next round, until one batch remains and its ranking is the final order. Both use the prompt in Section G.2 . We additionally extend the evaluation to candidate pools of K ∈ { 20 , 40 , 80 , 160 } K\in\{20,40,80,160\} ; Tables 20 and 8 report standard and oracle reranking results across these pool sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种方法，使用来自 Gemini-Embedding-2 的候选池，测试大型语言模型（LLM）是否能够重新排列检索器生成的候选项，将黄金论文排在更靠前的位置。 列表式重排序器将前 20 个候选项一次性提供给单个 LLM 调用，该调用会按排序后的顺序返回这些候选项。 锦标赛式重排序器通过以 b = 20 为一批对论文进行排序，并将每批中排名前 k = 4 的论文晋级下一轮，从而处理更大的候选池；这一过程持续进行，直到只剩下一批论文，其排序即为最终顺序。 两种方法均使用第 G.2 节中的提示词。 此外，我们将评估范围扩展至 K ∈ { 20 , 40 , 80 , 160 } 的候选池；表 20 和表 8 报告了在这些不同池规模下标准重排序和理想重排序的结果。

paragraphs.en: Setup. Our main experimental setup keeps every backbone’s knowledge cutoff before every source paper and gives the agent neither the source paper nor web access. This section asks what happens when these restrictions are lifted: whether newer backbones gain from having seen the source papers, and how much the source paper, the web, or its bibliography would help. We use two slices of the author-written set, matched by primary arXiv category. The pre-cutoff slice contains 23 source papers published between February 12 and December 23, 2025, with two cs.SE slots filled by cs.CE and cs.MA papers. The post-cutoff slice contains 23 source papers published between May 8 and August 14, 2026, four months later. A backbone whose cutoff falls between the slices can have seen the first but not the second.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们的主要实验设置确保每个骨干模型的知识截止时间早于每篇源论文，并且智能体既无法访问源论文，也无法访问网络。 本节探讨当这些限制被解除时会发生什么：较新的骨干模型是否因接触过源论文而受益，以及源论文、网络或其参考文献能在多大程度上提供帮助。 我们使用了作者撰写集合中的两个子集，这些子集按主要的 arXiv 类别进行匹配。 截止时间前的子集包含 23 篇于 2025 年 2 月 12 日至 12 月 23 日期间发表的源论文，其中两个 cs.SE 名额由 cs.CE 和 cs.MA 领域的论文填补。 截止时间后的子集包含 23 篇于 2026 年 5 月 8 日至 8 月 14 日期间发表的源论文，比前者晚四个月。 一个知识截止时间介于这两个子集之间的骨干模型可能接触过第一个子集的论文，但接触不到第二个子集的论文。

paragraphs.en: The cutoff split shows no sign that stronger backbones gain from having seen the source papers. paragraphs.en: With the same source context, search adds more to weak backbones than to strong ones. Figure 10 holds the February 2026 cutoff fixed across the GPT-5.6 family and varies capability through Luna’s reasoning effort and the model tier. Given the source abstract, the agent beats recall from memory by 0.25 for Luna at no reasoning effort, and the gap shrinks to within noise for the stronger runs. paragraphs.en: Agents in the main setting see only titles and abstracts. An abstract states a paper’s main result but often omits other critical details, so a gold paper could look unrelated to the question from its abstract alone. Indexing full text is not a simple fix, since embedding-based retrievers handle long documents poorly ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) and a paper’s body far exceeds the input length they are trained on. We therefore keep search over abstracts and instead let the agent read more of the papers it finds, testing whether that extra text helps it judge and pursue candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 主设置中的智能体只能看到标题和摘要。 摘要会说明一篇论文的主要成果，但通常会省略其他关键细节，因此仅凭摘要来看，一篇高质量论文可能与问题看似无关。 对全文进行索引并非一个简单的解决方案，因为基于嵌入的检索器处理长文档的效果不佳（Zhu 等人，2024），而一篇论文的正文内容远远超过了它们训练时所用的输入长度。 因此，我们仍然在摘要范围内进行搜索，但转而让智能体阅读更多它找到的论文内容，以测试这些额外文本是否有助于它判断和筛选候选论文。

paragraphs.en: Four policies add to the abstract the introduction, the method sections, the bibliography, or both the introduction and the bibliography. A fifth returns the full paper, and a sixth lets the agent request one section from a list returned by a second tool. Introductions are matched by their heading, methods by headings containing method, approach, model, framework, algorithm, or architecture, and bibliographies by references or bibliography. If no heading matches, the tool returns the abstract. Each read is capped at 12,000 characters, about 41% of the body at the median for papers read in full, and an included bibliography has its own 6,000-character cap.
paragraphs.zh: 四种策略会向摘要中添加引言、方法部分、参考文献，或者同时添加引言和参考文献。 第五种策略返回整篇论文，第六种策略则允许智能体从第二个工具返回的列表中请求某个特定部分。 引言通过其标题进行匹配，方法部分通过包含“方法”“方法途径”“模型”“框架”“算法”或“架构”的标题进行匹配，而参考文献则通过引用或参考文献列表进行匹配。 如果没有匹配的标题，该工具将返回摘要。 每次读取的内容最多限制为 12,000 个字符，约占完整阅读论文正文中位数的 41%，而包含的参考文献部分则有独立的 6,000 字符限制。

paragraphs.en: Coverage: agents rarely find gold papers beyond the retriever’s pool. Table 26 splits gold papers by two outcomes, whether Gemini-Emb-2 retrieves them in its top 100 and whether each agent ranks them in its own top 20. The retriever’s top 100 covers 70% of gold papers, and the agents recover almost none of the rest. About half of gold papers are returned by no search during an agent’s run. The first search, which uses the query as written, accounts for about two-thirds of the gold papers an agent sees, and follow-up searches add few. The grep agent, which writes its own search commands instead of using the retriever, keeps only 8% of the gold papers the retriever covers.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围：智能体很少能在检索器提供的论文池之外找到黄金论文。 表 26 根据两种结果对黄金论文进行了分类：Gemini-Emb-2 是否在前 100 条结果中检索到这些论文，以及每个智能体是否将它们排入自己的前 20 名。 检索器的前 100 条结果覆盖了 70% 的黄金论文，而智能体几乎未能检索到其余的论文。 在智能体的运行过程中，大约一半的黄金论文没有任何一次搜索被返回。 第一次搜索直接使用原始查询，占智能体所接触到的黄金论文的大约三分之二，而后续搜索几乎没有增加新的结果。 grep 智能体不依赖检索器，而是自行编写搜索命令，但它仅保留了检索器所覆盖的黄金论文中的 8%。

paragraphs.en: Recognition: agents usually explain gold papers the way the authors do. For the gold papers an agent does rank highly, we check whether its backbone understands why they matter. For each of the 238 core research query gold papers in the tool-calling agent’s top 20, GPT-4.1 explains from the query, title, and abstract how the paper could help pursue the query, and a GPT-4.1 judge compares this explanation with the author’s rationale. Of the 219 pairs whose author rationale is long enough to compare, 76% describe the same relationship, and almost all others describe a different but valid one (Table 30 ). Because the same model writes and judges, this agreement is an upper estimate. The analysis also shows only that the backbone can explain a paper’s relevance once given it, not that this understanding is why the paper entered the ranking.

paragraphs.en: Table 31 reports the search effort, API cost and time per query of each agent in Table 3 . With GPT-4.1 and o3, the grep and deep research agents carry a growing context through 14 to 20 tool calls per query and cost about eight times as much as the tool-calling agent, which makes few searches and scores each pooled paper in a short, separate call. With Claude Fable 5.1 the tool-calling agent issues more than twice as many searches within the same five rounds, and every agent costs more than a dollar per query. Times are medians over queries run in parallel and include API latency and retries, so they vary with provider load.

paragraphs.en: We construct ScholarCatalyst through an end-to-end pipeline that transforms raw arXiv papers into benchmark instances for inspiration literature retrieval. Starting from recent computer science papers, the pipeline constructs a collection of source papers, reconstructs benchmark annotations, assembles a retrieval corpus with a time cutoff, and augments benchmark instances through candidate retrieval and validation. Figure 3 summarizes the overall construction pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个端到端的流程构建 ScholarCatalyst，该流程将原始的 arXiv 论文转化为用于启发文献检索的基准实例。 从近期的计算机科学论文出发，该流程构建了一个源论文集合，重构了基准标注，使用时间截断组建了检索语料库，并通过候选检索与验证来增强基准实例。 图 3 总结了整体的构建流程。

sents.en: We construct ScholarCatalyst through an end-to-end pipeline that transforms raw arXiv papers into benchmark instances for inspiration literature retrieval.
sents.zh: 我们通过一个端到端的流程构建 ScholarCatalyst，该流程将原始的 arXiv 论文转化为用于启发文献检索的基准实例。

paragraphs.en: Existing publicly available scientific corpus ( Lo et al., 2020 ) and kaggle arXiv datasets 6 6 6 https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sumitm004/arxiv-scientific-research-papers-dataset do not provide the combination of recency, full-text representation, bibliography information, and citation relations required by our setting. We therefore build directly from raw arXiv data, processing each paper into a structured representation with explicit citation links that supports all subsequent stages of benchmark construction.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的公开可用科学语料库（Lo et al., 2020）和 Kaggle arXiv 数据集 6 6 6 https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sumitm004/arxiv-scientific-research-papers-dataset 并未提供我们设定所需的时效性、全文表示、参考文献信息和引用关系组合。 因此，我们直接从原始 arXiv 数据构建数据集，将每篇论文处理为结构化表示，并包含显式的引用链接，以支持基准构建的所有后续阶段。

paragraphs.en: We enumerate candidate source papers from recent oral and spotlight lists for recent AI conferences, match each accepted paper to its arXiv preprint by title, and exclude surveys and review articles. For each paper, we obtain a structured representation from the arXiv HTML rendering when available and otherwise by converting the corresponding L a T e X source using LaTeXML 7 7 7 LaTeXML project: https://math.nist.gov/~BMiller/LaTeXML/ , which better preserves document structure and citation information than PDF-based processing ( Frankston et al., 2024 ) . Because some papers cannot be reliably converted due to source formatting or parsing failures, we apply quality filtering to remove papers with incomplete text or citation structure. The resulting full text is converted into a structured representation in which inline citations are replaced with explicit citation markers linked to bibliography entries, providing a citation-grounded representation for all downstream stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从近期人工智能会议的口头报告列表和焦点报告列表中枚举候选源论文，通过标题将每篇被接受的论文与其 arXiv 预印本进行匹配，并排除综述文章和评论文章。 对于每篇论文，如果可用，我们从 arXiv 的 HTML 渲染版本中获取结构化表示；否则，则使用 LaTeXML 7 7 7 LaTeXML 项目（https://math.nist.gov/~BMiller/LaTeXML/）转换相应的 L a T e X 源文件。与基于 PDF 的处理方式相比，LaTeXML 能更好地保留文档结构和引用信息（Frankston et al., 2024）。 由于某些论文因源格式问题或解析失败而无法可靠转换，我们对这些论文进行质量过滤，以去除文本或引用结构不完整的论文。 最终得到的全文被转换为结构化表示，其中内联引用被替换为与参考文献条目相关联的显式引用标记，从而为所有下游阶段提供以引用为基础的表达形式。

paragraphs.en: We resolve every cited reference to a canonical scholarly record using the arXiv 8 8 8 https://arxiv.org , Semantic Scholar 9 9 9 https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api , and OpenAlex ( Priem et al., 2022 ) APIs based on the bibliography text. Citation parsing, inconsistent bibliography formatting, and search engine limitations occasionally prevent reliable resolution of the intended paper. We retain only source papers for which at least 70% of cited references are successfully resolved, and discard the rest before they proceed to the remaining pipeline stages, ensuring sufficient citation coverage for annotation reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: From the structured source paper, we automatically reconstruct the benchmark instances. The model (Gemini 3.1 pro) reads the full paper together with its bibliography to recover the motivating research question (query q q , one CoreQ and several SubQ s), inspiration papers (positive papers D q + D_{q}^{+} ) for each query. It further generates detailed rationales explaining how each selected paper contributed to the resulting research. These annotations form the benchmark instances used throughout the evaluation. This reconstruction uses the prompts provided in Appendix G.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从结构化的源论文中自动重建基准实例。 该模型（Gemini 3.1 pro）会通读整篇论文及其参考文献，以恢复每个查询的初始研究问题（查询 q q，一个 CoreQ 和多个 SubQ），以及相关的启发论文（正向论文 D q + D_{q}^{+}）。 它还会生成详细的推理说明，解释每篇被选中的论文如何为最终的研究成果做出贡献。 这些标注构成了整个评估过程中使用的基准实例。 此重建过程使用了附录 G.3 中提供的提示词。

paragraphs.en: We augment the benchmark beyond the paper’s cited bibliography by recovering insightful papers that were not cited. For each retrieval query, we retrieve the top-15 candidate papers from the corpus using both sparse (BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) ) and dense (Qwen3 8B embeddings ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) ) retrieval systems, deduplicate them, and rerank with a reasoning model (Gemini-3.6-flash) that scores each candidate for scientific relevance to the query rather than mere topical similarity. We retain the top 10 for author review, where authors mark inspiring papers as positives and closely related but non-inspiring papers as hard negatives.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过找回那些未被引用的有见地的论文，从而在基准测试中补充了论文所引用的文献之外的内容。 对于每个检索查询，我们使用稀疏（BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009））和密集（Qwen3 8B 嵌入（Zhang et al., 2025b））两种检索系统从语料库中检索出前 15 篇候选论文，然后进行去重，并用推理模型（Gemini-3.6-flash）重新排序；该模型根据每篇候选论文与查询在科学相关性上的得分进行判断，而非仅基于主题相似性。 我们保留排名前 10 的论文供作者评审，作者需将具有启发性的论文标记为正向样本，而高度相关但缺乏启发性的论文则标记为困难负向样本。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval corpus. We construct a retrieval corpus containing 190,896 papers. The corpus includes resolved references cited by our source papers together with a pool of 181K additional arXiv papers published between 2020 and 2024, drawn from five main computer science domains (cs.CL, cs.CV, cs.LG, cs.RO, and cs.AI), each restricted to papers with at least 1 citation. To construct a realistic literature pool beyond the cited literature, we estimate the citation distribution of recent ICML, ICLR, and NeurIPS oral and highlight papers and use it to determine the publication-year and category distributions of additional corpus papers. At retrieval time, we additionally apply a per-query temporal cutoff based on the query’s source-paper publication date, restricting candidate documents to those published no later than the query paper itself. This precludes temporal leakage, ensuring that no candidate postdates the query paper it is retrieved for.
paragraphs.zh: 检索语料库。 我们构建了一个包含 190,896 篇论文的检索语料库。 该语料库包括我们的源论文所引用的已解析参考文献，以及 2020 年至 2024 年间发表的 18.1 万篇额外的 arXiv 论文，这些论文来自五个主要计算机科学领域（cs.CL、cs.CV、cs.LG、cs.RO 和 cs.AI），每个领域的论文均限定为至少有 1 次引用的论文。 为了构建一个超越已引用文献的更贴近实际的文献池，我们估算了近期 ICML、ICLR 和 NeurIPS 口头报告及亮点论文的引用分布，并据此确定了语料库中额外论文的发表年份和类别分布。 在检索时，我们还根据查询所用源论文的发表日期，对每次查询应用一个时间截断限制，将候选文档限定为不晚于该查询论文本身发表的文档。 这避免了时间信息泄露，确保任何候选文档都不会晚于其被检索所依据的查询论文。

paragraphs.en: We developed a web-based interface through which authors annotate their own research projects. For each source paper, authors write or revise a research question intended to reflect their pre-solution information state. They organize the question into distinct research subfields and identify prior papers that provided meaningful scientific inspiration for each direction. Authors then review additional candidate papers, labeling papers that provided meaningful inspiration as positives and plausible but non-inspirational papers as hard negatives. For each judgment, they provide a rationale explaining how the paper did or did not contribute to the development of the target work. The resulting author-written instances contain research questions, positive and hard-negative labels, and open-ended rationales.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个基于网络的界面，作者可以通过该界面标注自己的研究项目。 对于每篇源论文，作者都会撰写或修改一个研究问题，以反映他们在提出解决方案之前的信息状态。 他们将问题划分为不同的研究子领域，并确定哪些早期论文为每个方向提供了有意义的科学启发。 随后，作者会审阅其他候选论文，将提供有意义启发的论文标记为“正例”，而看似合理但缺乏启发性的论文则标记为“困难负例”。 对于每一项判断，他们都会给出理由，说明该论文如何促进或未能促进目标工作的进展。 最终由作者撰写的实例包含了研究问题、正例和困难负例的标签，以及开放式的理由说明。
